== Trivia ==
* An [http://www.thefreedictionary.com/ungula ungula] is an arcane term for hoof. The more commonly used zoological term is [http://www.thefreedictionary.com/unguis unguis], i.e. a nail, claw, or hoof.
** The game uses ''Mantid Ungues'', which is the appropriate plural for ''unguis''. However, the appropriate plural form of ''ungula'' is ''ungulae''.
